chunks: Say: "I am a man like you, (but) it is revealed to me that your God is one God, so take the straight path to Him, and ask Him to forgive your sins. Woe to the idolaters"

key_terms.فَاسْتَقِيمُوا: So be steadfast / Take the straight path

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'I am a man like you' in Surah Fussilat?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the Prophet's humanity to distinguish his prophetic authority from divine essence, affirming that his message is purely revealed (Wahi) rather than self-derived. It emphasizes the practical path of Tawhid through steadfast obedience (Istiqamah) and seeking forgiveness, while the warning to polytheists highlights the spiritual corruption of associating partners with God. This duality reinforces the Shia understanding of the Prophet as the perfect human model who bridges the gap between the divine and the created.
